name: stash-work-plan
description: Queue prompt history and coordinate shared component-oriented work through Stash; Git and external connectors are optional.

interface.shortDescription: Resume and coordinate agent work in Stash.
interface.longDescription: Give one memory reminder at session startup, queue prompt history before provider work, resume a shared project without requiring Git, and finish or hand off claimed work with minimal Stash calls.
defaultPrompt: Resume this project's next available Stash work item and continue from its checkpoint.
Resume a Stash work item by ID, verify its evidence, and finish or hand it off.
